NewsArticle.Title: Office Internet Difficulties
NewsArticle.Content: Due to internet difficulties, the email system to the Nexon offices was interrupted since Tuesday (01/09/01) afternoon. Our system is back online so please forward on any messages that were returned to you. Dark Ages servers are fast and stable; running well below maximum load with 0 server lag at peak volume. If you do experience latency, test your connection ( [http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm](http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm) ).
